default.console_collectActorTags_tooltip:
collectActorTags [optional string actionTag ...]
require target
Collects the image-generation prompt tags (LLMUtils.CollectActorTags) the game would gather for the current target and prints them into the debug log: prompt profile rules (hair/eye color, hairstyle, body type, skin color...), visible organs, the promptTags of every visible equipped item. Every extra word is passed as an action tag for the rules (e.g. collectActorTags sex unsafe spread_pussy); the tag combat also adds the promptTags of weapons carried in the inventory. Useful for checking which danbooru-style tags a character contributes to image generation
default.console_collectSceneTags_tooltip:
collectSceneTags [optional self]
require target (self = the player)
Scene image prompt of what the actor is doing (its current job + interaction job): prints the collected tags (actors with short tags, interactions, counts, scene tags after the derived tags), the applied rules, every prompt section and the flat prompt. Rules: prompt_* sections of Mods/Assetpacks/Image_Generation_Config.json, re-read and re-rolled on every call
default.console_generateSceneImage_tooltip:
generateSceneImage [optional self]
require target (self = the player)
Builds the scene prompt and sends it to ComfyUI (http://127.0.0.1:8188) using Mods/Assetpacks/ComfyUI.json. Replaces $composition$ $scene$ $location$ $actions$ $actors$ $mainActors$ $secondaryActors$ $actors_complex$ $actors_simple$ $prompt$ $seed$ $wd14_threshold$ $wd14_character_threshold$ $exclude_tags$. Main = the target; secondary = everyone else; complex = actors with more than 10 full prompt tags, excluding the short tag (list). Simple includes every actor, including the main actor and POV player: full prompt at 10 tags or fewer, otherwise shortPrompt (short tag, skin color, body shape, always-visible body tags). Entries are concatenated in actor order with duplicates kept. Downloads the MisteraOutput batch (else the first image output) to Mods/Assetpacks/_generated/temp_N.ext. Classifies each image for the main actor using scene data and optional WD14TaggerScoredImage scores from the same workflow; missing tags use scene data only. Copies classified images and JSON sidecars into _generated/<portrait template ID>/<category>/ and registers them for lazy portrait refresh without restarting. Skipped images stay in temp output; temp.json and the log include tag records, final paths, and skip reasons. One request at a time; generated assets respect safe mode and the _generated pack toggle
